item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Melania Trump hosted Russian and Ukrainian officials at the White House, urging a lasting truce while fighting continued on multiple fronts. Russian drones struck an Ozon warehouse in southern Russia and a Ukrainian aid centre, raising the death toll at the aid point to 53, according to Reuters. Ukraine responded with drone attacks on the Ryazan refinery and on sites in Dnipropetrovsk and Kyiv oblasts, injuring four people. Germany announced an additional €100 million for Ukrainian infrastructure and Italy prepared fresh military aid despite coalition splits. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

A Kenyan preacher who urged followers to starve to death was sentenced to 200 years in prison, and a UN clash with Sudan over Abyei’s inclusion in December elections has drawn Security Council attention to the region. Coffee gatherings are being used to rebuild trust in communities, and women in Tambura are crossing ethnic divides to promote peace, while a border clinic faces closure risk for 100,000 people.
